title: Large Language Models and their Awareness of Mechanics and Spatial Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2608.14615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on established code-generation and mathematical-reasoning benchmarks, but their capabilities in mechanics and spatial geometry, here denoted as mechanical engineering awareness, has not been quantified systematically. We present MecEng, a fully automated benchmark that evaluates LLMs on the creation of multibody simulation models from parameterized textual descriptions. The benchmark comprises 84 generic tasks on three difficulty levels, ranging from rigid-body systems with joints and contact to flexible multibody systems that require exact 3D geometry generation, tetrahedral finite-element meshing, and Hurty-Craig-Bampton model order reduction of machine parts. A dedicated pipeline with LLMs generates simulation-ready geometry from text using Netgen, and builds multibody system models for the code Exudyn, which are then verified against expert ground truth on several levels: system-graph isomorp

translated_title: 大型语言模型及其对力学与空间几何的感知能力
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在既有的代码生成和数学推理基准测试中表现优异，但它们在力学和空间几何领域的能力（此处称为机械工程感知）尚未被系统量化。我们提出了MecEng，一个全自动基准测试，用于评估LLMs根据参数化文本描述创建多体仿真模型的能力。该基准包含84个通用任务，分为三个难度级别，从带关节和接触的刚体系统，到需要精确3D几何生成、四面体有限元网格划分以及机器部件Hurty-Craig-Bampton模型降阶的柔性多体系统。一个专用流水线利用LLMs，通过Netgen从文本生成仿真就绪的几何形状，并为代码Exudyn构建多体系统模型，然后根据专家真实数据在多个层面进行验证：系统图同构。
tldr: 本文提出了MecEng，一个全自动基准测试，首次系统量化了大型语言模型在力学和空间几何（机械工程感知）方面的能力，涵盖从刚体到柔性多体系统的84个任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MecEng, a fully automated benchmark that systematically quantifies large language models' capabilities in mechanics and spatial geometry (mechanical engineering awareness), covering 84 tasks from rigid-body to flexible multibody systems.
